+import logging
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog.stdlib import ExtraAdder, ProcessorFormatter
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("allow", [None, ["shared", "fresh"], []])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("overwrite", [True, False])
+def test_collision_policy(allow, overwrite):
+    rec = logging.LogRecord("sample", logging.INFO, "app.py", 1, "original", (), None)
+    rec.shared = "record"
+    rec.fresh = 7
+    ed = {"_record": rec, "shared": "event", "untouched": None}
+    expected = ed.copy()
+    if allow is None or "shared" in allow:
+        expected["shared"] = "record" if overwrite else "event"
+    if allow is None or "fresh" in allow:
+        expected["fresh"] = 7
+    assert ExtraAdder(allow, overwrite=overwrite)(None, "info", ed) == expected
+
+
+def test_default_still_overwrites():
+    rec = logging.LogRecord("sample", logging.INFO, "app.py", 1, "original", (), None)
+    rec.shared = "record"
+    ed = {"_record": rec, "shared": "event"}
+    assert ExtraAdder()(None, "info", ed)["shared"] == "record"
+
+
+def test_allow_is_snapshotted():
+    rec = logging.LogRecord("sample", logging.INFO, "app.py", 1, "original", (), None)
+    rec.shared = "record"
+    rec.fresh = 7
+    allow = ["shared"]
+    proc = ExtraAdder(allow, overwrite=False)
+    allow.append("fresh")
+    ed = {"_record": rec, "shared": "event"}
+    assert proc(None, "info", ed) == {"_record": rec, "shared": "event"}
+
+
+def test_foreign_formatter_preserves_preexisting_event():
+    rec = logging.LogRecord("sample", logging.INFO, "app.py", 1, "original", (), None)
+    rec.event = "extra"
+    fmt = ProcessorFormatter(
+        foreign_pre_chain=[ExtraAdder(overwrite=False)],
+        processors=[lambda logger, method, ed: ed["event"]],
+    )
+    assert fmt.format(rec) == "original"
+
+
+def test_false_policy_can_copy_standard_fields_when_allowed():
+    rec = logging.LogRecord("sample", logging.INFO, "app.py", 1, "original", (), None)
+    ed = {"_record": rec, "name": None}
+    result = ExtraAdder(["name", "levelno"], overwrite=False)(None, "info", ed)
+    assert result["name"] is None
+    assert result["levelno"] == logging.INFO
+
+
+def test_without_record_is_noop():
+    ed = {"shared": "event"}
+    assert ExtraAdder(overwrite=False)(None, "info", ed) == {"shared": "event"}

spec.question: Add a keyword-only `overwrite: bool = True` option to `structlog.stdlib.ExtraAdder`. The default must retain current behavior. With `overwrite=False`, copy eligible LogRecord attributes only when their keys are absent from the event dictionary; an existing value of `None`, `False`, or an empty string still counts as present. This policy must work both with `allow=None` and with an explicit allow collection, including explicitly allowed standard LogRecord fields. Preserve the existing allow-list snapshot behavior and the no-op behavior when `_record` is absent. In a ProcessorFormatter foreign pre-chain, this should let an existing event field win over an extra attribute of the same name. Deliver a unified diff against non-test repository files.
